questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Köhler ist Deutscher.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler is a German.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er will nach Amerika fahren.

answers.answer_text: He's planning to go to America.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er muss eine Geschäftsreise machen.

answers.answer_text: He's obliged to go on business.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er geht zum Konsulat.

answers.answer_text: He goes to the consulate.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dort beantragt er ein Visum.

answers.answer_text: There he applies for a visa.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Im Konsulat trifft er einen Bekannten.

answers.answer_text: At the consulate he meets an acquaintance.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dieser heisst John Allen.

answers.answer_text: This (person) is called John Allen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er fragt ihn, wo die Visa-Abteilung ist.

answers.answer_text: He asks him where the visa section is.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen geht mit ihm zu seinem Kollegen, Herrn Jones.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen accompanies him to his colleague, Mr. Jones.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Jones ist Vizekonsul in der Visa-Abteilung.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Jones is a vice-consul in the visa section.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen macht die Herren bekannt.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen introduces the gentlemen to each other.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Will Herr Köhler auswandern?

answers.answer_text: Does Mr. Köhler want to emigrate?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wie lange will er bleiben?

answers.answer_text: How long does he intend to stay?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hat er einen Ausweis?

answers.answer_text: Does he have an identification card?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Köhler zeigt ihm seinen Pass.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler shows him his passport.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Jones gibt ihm ein Formular (einen Fragebogen).

answers.answer_text: Mr. Jones gives him a form (a questionnaire).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das muss Herr Köhler ausfüllen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler has to fill that out.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen und Herr Köhler sprechen dann zusammen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen and Mr. Köhler then talk together.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herrn Allen gefällt es gut in Bremen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen likes it a lot in Bremen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Seiner Frau gefällt das Klima aber nicht.

answers.answer_text: His wife doesn't like the climate however.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie und ihr Sohn möchten lieber in Bayern wohnen.

answers.answer_text: She and their son would rather live in Bavaria.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Köhler kann das gut verstehen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler can well understand that.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er ist kein Bremer.

answers.answer_text: He is not originally from Bremen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Seine Heimatstadt ist Berlin.

answers.answer_text: His home town is Berlin.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen und Herr Köhler möchten noch etwas trinken.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen and Mr. Köhler would just like to get something to drink.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen trinkt nicht gern Wein.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen doesn't like wine.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er trinkt lieber Pilsner Bier.

answers.answer_text: He prefers Pilsner beer.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Köhler trinkt aber lieber Würzburger.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler however likes Würzburger better.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Leider gibt es in diesem Restaurant kein Löwenbräu.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately there's no Löwenbräu to be had at this restaurant.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen trinkt Löwenbräu am liebsten.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen likes Löwenbräu best.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Köhler raucht gern Pfeife.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler likes to smoke a pipe.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Leider hat er keinen Tabak mehr.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately he doesn't have any tobacco left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er sucht ein Zigarrengeschäft.

answers.answer_text: He's looking for a cigar store.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Neben dem Restaurant ist eins.

answers.answer_text: There's one next to the restaurant.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Allen bietet ihm eine Zigarre an.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Allen offers him a cigar.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Aber Herr Köhler raucht keine Zigarren.

answers.answer_text: However Mr. Köhler doesn't smoke any cigars.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Allens wohnen in einem Neubau am Rande der Stadt.

answers.answer_text: The Allens live in a new building on the outskirts of town.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihre Adresse ist Schillerstrasse 4.

answers.answer_text: Their address is 4 Schiller Street.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Köhler soll sie am Sonntag nachmittag um vier besuchen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Köhler is supposed to visit them on Sunday afternoon at four.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Am Sonntag passt es ihm aber leider nicht gut.

answers.answer_text: Unfortunately Sunday is not convenient for him, however.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hat schon eine Verabredung.

answers.answer_text: He already has an engagement.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Am Sonnabend passt es ihm besser.

answers.answer_text: Saturday is more convenient for him.
